plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.

conservative.read: This plan aims for lower, steadier returns around 1.5% per month. The focus is on preserving capital by significantly reducing leverage and concentrating on income and broad market exposure, leading to lower potential drawdowns.

moves.note: Increase position in strong tech name

plan: Trim SOXL and SPAL to bring leveraged ETFs within mandate.

Buy AMZU as a new, high-scoring tech opportunity.

This plan balances risk reduction with targeted growth in quality names.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% monthly growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding new, high-scoring opportunities. Expect moderate growth with controlled risk.

plan: Increase SOXL and SPAL to leverage upside potential.
Add to SMH and CRWD to concentrate in strong sectors.
Buy AMZU as a new, high-conviction tech play.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% monthly growth by leaning into leverage and concentration. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-conviction tech names. Be aware that this strategy carries substantially higher risk, including amplified drawdowns and potential for rapid losses due to leverage and ETF decay.

plan: Sell all SOXL, SPAL, SMH, and CRWD to remove volatile assets.

income.read: This income-focused plan aims for steady monthly distributions, prioritizing capital preservation over growth. Returns are variable and depend on distributions, not just NAV. While designed for low drawdowns, NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
